built: caries phase-1 v3 — real negative class
join: MD5 of image bytes between quadrant_enumeration and quadrant-enumeration-disease; filenames are NOT comparable
crop: 1.0x tight, floor near / ceil far, 224x224 (the caries contract)
assumption: a tooth with no disease annotation is PRESUMED not-diseased. DENTEX annotates only diseased teeth, so this is absence of evidence: any lesion the annotators missed enters the negative class as a false negative. Unmeasurable inside DENTEX; report it with any result.
